text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The passion you poured into that split-second battle... was magnificent. You had truly wonderful fire in your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Pleased to meet you, velvet one.
Encounters truly are a strange thing.
Guided by the Trainer, a new bond has been forged...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... From this day forth, you shall be strung up
and become the guardian deity of my bag...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fear not, however. Snatched from your sanctuary
of glass and made my servant, I shall bestow at
least a token blessing upon your pitiful self...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A miraculous elixir that wards off all impurities
and repels aquatic perilsâ

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it is known as "waterproofing spray"!
Trainer, we are stopping by the home improvement center on our way back!
